Doha, Qatar – Life goes on in between war sirens and the call to prayer…





Video

Joined BBC to discuss second week of the US-Israel war on Iran, escalating strikes across Tehran, the mounting civilian toll (1300+ killed) and widespread infrastructure damage, and how residents are coping with daily life under sustained bombardment.

Video

Spoke to @AJEnglish on the third week of the U.S.-Israel war on #Iran with Ross Harrison.

Video

Spoke to @AJEnglish in Doha on the third week of war as people across the region celebrate Eid and the Persian new year Nowruz. (With @georgetownprof)

Video

Spoke to Aljazeera about Israel and Iran’s attacks on oil fields that is a major escalation and the path forward for a war that has devastated the region and is unpopular in the U.S.

Video

Joined NPR to discuss US-Israel war on Iran, closing of the Strait of Hormuz, the global oil market, and the bombing of Kharg island. This war has already taken thousands of lives in the Middle East including hundreds of children.

In Doha, Qatar to cover the U.S.-Israel war on #Iran that has devastated tens of millions of lives across this beautiful region.

Video

Told Chicago Sun Times that the attack on the elementary school in Minab is just another example of how little the West and its key Middle East ally care about protecting civilians when they bomb Muslim populations.
chicago.suntimes.com/columni…

Well explained @brhodes.

To understand, imagine the reverse: if #Iran bombed an elementary school in the US and killed 150+ children, the world would call it what it is - a horror and a crime.

Children in Minab deserve the same outrage. Moral clarity shouldn’t depend on whose children they are.


Ben Rhodes (@brhodes)
